title: Casefile Revisited: Lauria Bible & Ashley Freeman

sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她曾被斩首，体内的血液也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来她的凶手费尽心思来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名氏简·多伊。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是“罪案档案呈现”推出的全新系列，现已上线，各大播客平台均可收听。

sentences.en: As we enter Casefile's 10th year, we've created a new run of special bonus content.
sentences.zh: 随着我们迎来《罪案档案》的第十年，我们制作了一系列全新的特别额外内容。

sentences.en: Casefile Archives, a series of releases revisiting the earliest years of the show, along with previously unreleased premium episodes.
sentences.zh: 《罪案档案资料库》回顾了节目最初几年的内容，并包含此前从未发布的高级单集。

sentences.en: This is completely additional content and will not replace new episodes.
sentences.zh: 这些完全是额外的内容，不会取代新的单集。

sentences.en: We'll still be back on March 7 with brand new cases, and we'll be releasing the same number of new episodes this year as we did last year.
sentences.zh: 我们仍将于3月7日带着全新的案件回归，并且今年发布的新单集数量将与去年相同。

sentences.en: Casefile Archives is simply a way to mark the 10th year, revisit some older episodes,
sentences.zh: 《罪案档案资料库》仅仅是一种庆祝第十年、回顾一些老节目的方式，

sentences.en: and to offer previously subscriber-exclusive episodes to the wider audience for the first time.
sentences.zh: 并且首次向广大听众提供此前仅限订阅者收听的节目。

sentences.en: For the re-release episodes, we have fully edited, polished, re-recorded, and freshly produced them from start to finish to match our current production standards.
sentences.zh: 对于这些重新发布的单集，我们从头到尾进行了彻底的剪辑、润色、重新录制和全新制作，以符合我们当前的制作标准。

sentences.en: They are not full rewrites.
sentences.zh: 它们并非完全重写。

sentences.en: Our aim isn't to reshape the cases or alter the original storytelling, but to preserve them as they were first told,
sentences.zh: 我们的目的不是重塑案件或改变最初的叙事方式，而是尽可能保留它们最初讲述时的原貌，

sentences.en: while giving them the level of production they didn't have back in 2016.
sentences.zh: 同时赋予它们2016年时不具备的制作水平。

sentences.en: Where appropriate, updates have been added, but the core structure remains faithful to the originals.
sentences.zh: 在适当的地方，我们添加了更新，但核心结构仍然忠于原作。

sentences.en: Because of this, these episodes may sound a little different to our recent work.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，这些单集听起来可能与我们最近的作品有些不同。

sentences.en: Today's re-release is Laura Bible and Ashley Freeman, the third Casefile episode ever produced.
sentences.zh: 今天重新发布的是劳拉·拜ible和阿什利·弗里曼案，这是《罪案档案》制作的第三个单集。

sentences.en: On December 30, 1999, a fire tore through a home in Welch, Oklahoma.
sentences.zh: 1999年12月30日，一场大火吞噬了俄克拉荷马州韦尔奇的一栋房屋。

sentences.en: Inside, police found the body of Ashley Freeman's mother, Kathy.
sentences.zh: 在屋内，警察发现了阿什利·弗里曼的母亲凯茜的尸体。

sentences.en: But Ashley, her best friend Laura Bible, and Ashley's father, Danny, were nowhere to be found.
sentences.zh: 但阿什利、她的闺蜜劳拉·拜ible以及阿什利的父亲丹尼却不见踪影。

sentences.en: Investigators soon confirmed the fire was deliberate and that Kathy hadn't died in the blaze.
sentences.zh: 调查人员很快确认火灾是人为蓄意造成的，且凯茜并非死于大火中。

sentences.en: She'd been killed before the house was set alight.
sentences.zh: 她在房屋被点燃之前就已经遇害了。

sentences.en: What followed was an investigation filled with missed opportunities and years of unanswered questions.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是长达数年充满错失良机和无数未解之谜的调查。

sentences.en: Originally released in January 2016, the case has seen a significant development since then, which has been included in this re-release version.
sentences.zh: 该案件最初于2016年1月发布，此后有了重大进展，这些进展已收录在本期重新发布的版本中。

sentences.en: Our episodes deal with serious and often distressing incidents.
sentences.zh: 我们的节目涉及严重且往往令人痛苦的事件。

sentences.en: If you feel at any time you need support, please contact your local crisis centre.
sentences.zh: 如果您觉得在任何时候需要支持，请联系您当地的危机中心。

sentences.en: For suggested phone numbers for confidential support and for a more detailed list of content warnings, please see the show notes for this episode on your app or on our website.
sentences.zh: 有关保密支持的建议电话号码以及更详细的内容警告列表，请查看您应用上或我们网站上的本期节目说明。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, December 29, 1999, Oklahoma teenager Ashley Freeman invited her best friend Laura Bible over for a sleepover to celebrate her 16th birthday.
sentences.zh: 1999年12月29日，星期三，俄克拉荷马州19岁的少女阿什利·弗里曼邀请她的闺蜜劳拉·拜ible来家过夜，以庆祝她的16岁生日。

sentences.en: The Freemans lived in a trailer on a rural property in the small town of Welch in Craig County.
sentences.zh: 弗里曼一家住在克雷格县小镇韦尔奇一处乡村地产的拖车房里。

sentences.en: Ashley's parents, Danny and Kathy Freeman, were also home that evening.
sentences.zh: 阿什利的父母丹尼和凯茜·弗里曼当晚也在家。

sentences.en: It was a relatively uneventful, albeit enjoyable night.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相对平静、甚至可以说是愉快的夜晚。

sentences.en: The girls ate cake and watched TV and nothing seemed out of the ordinary.
sentences.zh: 女孩们吃了蛋糕，看了电视，一切看起来都很正常。

sentences.en: But just before 6 o'clock the next morning, a passing neighbour reported that the Freeman house was on fire.
sentences.zh: 但就在第二天清晨6点前，一位路过的邻居报告说弗里曼家的房子着火了。

sentences.en: Emergency services rushed to the scene and found one body among the ashes.
sentences.zh: 紧急救援人员赶到现场，在灰烬中发现了一具尸体。

sentences.en: Laura Bible and Ashley Freeman both grew up in Veneta, a town in Craig County, Oklahoma, that had a population of around 6,500 people.
sentences.zh: 劳拉·拜ible和阿什利·弗里曼都在俄克拉荷马州克雷格县的韦内塔长大，那里的总人口大约有6500人。

sentences.en: They first met in kindergarten, where they formed an instant bond and became inseparable straight away.
sentences.zh: 她们在幼儿园初次相遇，一见如故，立刻形影不离。

sentences.en: As time went by, their bond only got stronger.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，她们的感情变得更加深厚。

sentences.en: They were best friends, about as close as friends could get.
sentences.zh: 她们是最好的朋友，关系亲密无间。

sentences.en: They shared the same thoughts and finished one another's sentences.
sentences.zh: 她们有着相同的想法，并且总能接上对方未说完的话。

sentences.en: Laura and Ashley attended the same schools and spent every minute of their time together.
sentences.zh: 劳拉和阿什利上同一所学校，每分每秒都呆在一起。

sentences.en: That was until 1995, when Ashley's parents announced that the Freemans were moving to Welch, a small town about 32 kilometres or 20 miles north of Veneta.
sentences.zh: 直到1995年，阿什利的父母宣布弗里曼一家要搬到韦尔奇，这是韦内塔以北约32公里或20英里处的一个小镇。

sentences.en: Welch was a rural area with a population of about 600 people.
sentences.zh: 韦尔奇是一个人口约600人的乡村地区。

sentences.en: The Freemans moved into a trailer on a 40-acre property in an isolated, quiet spot.
sentences.zh: 弗里曼一家搬进了一处坐落在偏远、安静地段、占地40英亩的房产里的拖车房。

sentences.en: It was a testing time for Laura and Ashley, but they remained close, speaking on the phone at least once a week and seeing each other as often as they could.
sentences.zh: 这对劳拉和阿什利来说是一段艰难的时期，但她们依然保持着密切联系，每周至少通一次电话，尽可能经常见面。

sentences.en: They were typical teenage girls, with a shared interest in hair, make-up, shopping and clothes.
sentences.zh: 她们是典型的青春期女孩，有着共同的兴趣爱好，比如发型、化妆、购物和衣服。

sentences.en: Both were excellent students who were in the top 10% of their classes.
sentences.zh: 两人都是优秀的优等生，成绩名列班级前10%。

sentences.en: Laura was a cheerleader with a deep love for animals, while Ashley was more of the athletic type.
sentences.zh: 劳拉是一名啦啦队长，对动物有着深厚的热爱，而阿什利则更偏向运动型。

sentences.en: She played in her high school basketball team and had a passion for hunting, having shot her first deer around the age of 12.
sentences.zh: 她是高中篮球队的成员，并且对打猎充满热情，在大约12岁时就射杀了她的第一只鹿。

sentences.en: Ashley had a part-time job at a local convenience store and was trying to save up to buy a car once she turned 16.
sentences.zh: 阿什利在当地一家便利店兼职，并试图存钱在16岁时买一辆车。

sentences.en: But while Ashley succeeded in her personal life, not everything was great for her at home.
sentences.zh: 但尽管阿什利在个人生活中取得了成功，她在家里并非一切都顺心如意。

sentences.en: Ashley's mother, Kathy Freeman, was described as a loving and caring person.
sentences.zh: 阿什利的母亲凯茜·弗里曼被形容为一个充满爱心和关怀的人。

sentences.en: She was a hard worker and the main breadwinner for the family.
sentences.zh: 她是一个工作努力的人，也是家庭的主要经济支柱。

sentences.en: However, Ashley's father, Danny, was known to have a violent temper.
sentences.zh: 然而，阿什利的父亲丹尼出了名的脾气暴躁。

sentences.en: After the family moved to Welch, there were reports that both Ashley and her older brother Shane started clashing with their father.
sentences.zh: 搬到韦尔奇后，有报道称阿什利和她的哥哥肖恩都开始与父亲发生冲突。

sentences.en: In 1998, Shane ran away from home and Danny rang the local sheriff's office to report him missing.
sentences.zh: 1998年，肖恩离家出走，丹尼打电话给当地警长办公室报告他失踪。

sentences.en: The police located Shane shortly after.
sentences.zh: 警方不久后找到了肖恩。

sentences.en: He explained that he'd run away because his dad had whipped him for being disobedient.
sentences.zh: 他解释说自己离家出走是因为父亲因为他不听话而狠狠抽了他。

sentences.en: Shane's injuries were significant enough that he was bleeding through his underwear and Danny Freeman was subsequently charged with assault.
sentences.zh: 肖恩的伤势十分严重，内裤都被血浸透了，因此丹尼·弗里曼随后被指控犯有殴打罪。

sentences.en: A court date was set for the following year, but four months later, something happened that irrevocably changed the Freeman household.
sentences.zh: 法庭开庭日期定在第二年，但在四个月后，发生了一件事，彻底改变了弗里曼一家的生活。

sentences.en: 17-year-old Shane had started to develop a taste for theft.
sentences.zh: 17岁的肖恩开始染上偷窃的嗜好。

sentences.en: On January 8, 1999, he stole his neighbour's vehicle as well as a gun.
sentences.zh: 1999年1月8日，他偷了邻居的汽车以及一把枪。

sentences.en: Deputy David Hayes from the Craig County Sheriff's Department later spotted the stolen vehicle on the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 克雷格县警长部门的副警长大卫·海斯随后在路边发现了这辆被盗车辆。

sentences.en: He approached the vehicle and saw Shane Freeman inside.
sentences.zh: 他走近车辆，看到肖恩·弗里曼坐在里面。

sentences.en: According to Deputy Hayes, Shane got out and pointed a gun at him.
sentences.zh: 据副警长海斯称，肖恩下车并用枪指着他。

sentences.en: Deputy Hayes pulled out his own firearm and screamed at Shane to drop the weapon.
sentences.zh: 副警长海斯拔出自己的枪，大声命令肖恩放下武器。

sentences.en: When Shane refused to do so, Deputy Hayes claimed he was forced to fire to protect himself.
sentences.zh: 当肖恩拒绝放下武器时，副警长海斯称他被迫开枪以保护自己。

sentences.en: Shane Freeman died instantly.
sentences.zh: 肖恩·弗里曼当场死亡。

sentences.en: An investigation by the County District Attorney found that Deputy Hayes was acting in self-defence and that the shooting was justified.
sentences.zh: 县地方检察官的调查发现，副警长海斯是在正当防卫，开枪是合理的。

sentences.en: It was a devastating blow for the Freeman family and Ashley struggled to come to terms with the death of her big brother.
sentences.zh: 这对弗里曼一家是个沉重的打击，阿什利很难接受哥哥的离世。

sentences.en: The Freemans also had grave doubts about Deputy Hayes' version of events.
sentences.zh: 弗里曼一家对副警长海斯的说法也抱有严重的怀疑。

sentences.en: They refused to accept that he'd acted in self-defence, believing it was a cold-blooded murder.
sentences.zh: 他们拒绝接受他是正当防卫的说法，认为这是一起冷血的谋杀。

sentences.en: Refusing to be quiet about it, the Freeman family started posting signs around town declaring justice for Shane.
sentences.zh: 弗里曼一家不愿保持沉默，开始在镇上张贴标语，宣称要为肖恩讨回公道。

sentences.en: This started a feud between the Freemans' and the local sheriff's office.
sentences.zh: 这引发了弗里曼一家与当地警长办公室之间的宿怨。

sentences.en: About a month after Shane's death, Danny Freeman was arrested after he was caught driving around trying to find out where Deputy Hayes lived.
sentences.zh: 在肖恩死后大约一个月，丹尼·弗里曼因开车四处打听副警长海斯的住址而被捕。

sentences.en: In response, deputies started sitting outside of the Freeman house in their patrol cars.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，副警长们开始把巡逻车停在弗里曼家屋外。

sentences.en: Tensions were high, with Danny yet to face court on the assault charges against his son.
sentences.zh: 紧张局势一触即发，丹尼尚未就其涉嫌殴打儿子的指控出庭受审。

sentences.en: Danny was ultimately acquitted of the charges, but regardless, it had been a tragic and stressful year for Ashley.
sentences.zh: 丹尼最终被判无罪，但无论如何，对阿什利来说，这是悲惨且压力重重的一年。

sentences.en: She was supported by Laura Bible, who played a huge part in helping Ashley come to terms with the loss of her brother.
sentences.zh: 劳拉·拜ible一直支持着她，在帮助阿什利接受哥哥离世这件事上发挥了巨大的作用。

sentences.en: By the time Ashley's 16th birthday rolled around on December 29, 1999, she didn't feel like having a big celebration.
sentences.zh: 1999年12月29日，阿什利迎来16岁生日时，她并不想大肆庆祝。

sentences.en: Instead, she just wanted to spend the day with her mother, Kathy, and of course, her best friend, Laura.
sentences.zh: 相反，她只想和母亲凯茜，当然还有她最好的朋友劳拉一起度过这一天。

sentences.en: The three went into town and spent the day shopping before having dinner at a local pizzeria.
sentences.zh: 三个人去镇上逛街度过了一天，随后在当地的一家比萨店吃晚饭。

sentences.en: Afterwards, Ashley asked Laura to sleep over so they could eat birthday cake and ice cream together.
sentences.zh: 之后，阿什利邀请劳拉留宿，这样她们就可以一起吃生日蛋糕和冰淇淋。

sentences.en: At around 7pm, they drove back to Laura's house to ask permission from her parents.
sentences.zh: 晚上7点左右，她们开车回到劳拉家征求她父母的同意。

sentences.en: Laura's parents said it was fine, as long as she was back in time for her dentist appointment the following morning.
sentences.zh: 劳拉的父母表示可以，只要她在第二天早上准时回来去看牙医就行。

sentences.en: Laura, who already had her driver's license and her own car, happily agreed.
sentences.zh: 已经拿到驾照并拥有自己汽车的劳拉愉快地答应了。

sentences.en: She took her purse with her, which contained about $200 in cash.
sentences.zh: 她随身带了自己的钱包，里面有大约200美元现金。

sentences.en: It was a low-key evening.
sentences.zh: 这是一个低调的夜晚。

sentences.en: The girls ate cake and watched a hunting show on TV with Kathy and Danny.
sentences.zh: 女孩们和凯茜、丹尼一起吃蛋糕，看电视上的打猎节目。

sentences.en: Ashley's boyfriend, Jeremy, stopped by to give Ashley her birthday present and then left at around 9.30pm.
sentences.zh: 阿什利的男朋友杰里米顺道来送了阿什利的生日礼物，随后在晚上9点半左右离开。

sentences.en: He didn't notice anything out of the ordinary.
sentences.zh: 他没有注意到任何异常情况。

sentences.en: It was a normal, quiet night with the Freemans and Laura just sitting around and chatting happily.
sentences.zh: 这是一个平常而安静的夜晚，弗里曼一家和劳拉坐在一起愉快地聊天。

sentences.en: Just before 6 o'clock the next morning of Thursday, December 30, a neighbour called emergency services to report that the Freeman house was on fire.
sentences.zh: 就在第二天12月30日星期四清晨6点前，一位邻居打电话给紧急救援人员，报告弗里曼家的房子着火了。

sentences.en: It was still dark at this time, before sunrise.
sentences.zh: 当时天色仍然很黑，太阳还没升起。

sentences.en: Volunteer firefighters rushed to the scene and found the house ablaze.
sentences.zh: 志愿消防员紧急赶赴现场，发现房屋正处于烈火之中。

sentences.en: Once they managed to extinguish the flames, officers from the Craig County Sheriff's Department determined the fire was arson and declared the area to be a crime scene.
sentences.zh: 一旦他们设法扑灭了大火，克雷格县警长部门的警官们就断定这场火灾是纵火，并宣布该地区为犯罪现场。

sentences.en: At around 7.30am, Laura's mother, Lorene Bible, was at work when she received a phone call from her son saying that the Freeman's house was on fire.
sentences.zh: 早上7点半左右，劳拉的母亲洛伦·拜ible正在上班，她接到儿子打来的电话，说弗里曼家的房子着火了。

sentences.en: After Lorene got off the phone, a deputy arrived almost straight away to break the news that only one body had been recovered from the fire.
sentences.zh: 洛伦刚挂断电话，一名副警长几乎立刻就赶到了，带来了火灾现场只找到一具尸体的消息。

sentences.en: Beyond that, there wasn't much else he was able to tell her.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，他能告诉她的就没多少了。

sentences.en: Lorene immediately called her husband and they both rushed to the scene.
sentences.zh: 洛伦立即打电话给丈夫，两人双双赶往现场。

sentences.en: Upon their arrival, they were shocked to see that the area had been cordoned off, but most of the deputies on site appeared to be just standing around.
sentences.zh: 他们到达后，震惊地发现该区域已被拉起警戒线，但现场的大多数副警长似乎只是站在一旁。

sentences.en: No one was searching through the debris or looked like they were doing much of anything.
sentences.zh: 没有人搜寻废墟，看起来也不像在做什么事。

sentences.en: The Bibles questioned the deputies about this and they explained that they were waiting for an agent from the Oklahoma State Bureau of Investigation, known as the OSBI, to arrive
sentences.zh: 拜ible夫妇向副警长们质问此事，他们解释说他们正在等待俄克拉荷马州调查局（简称OSBI）的特工赶到，

sentences.en: before the investigation could begin.
sentences.zh: 调查才能开始。

sentences.en: The OSBI is the state law enforcement agency for Oklahoma, which acts independently of the local county departments.
sentences.zh: OSBI是俄克拉荷马州的州级执法机构，独立于当地县级部门运作。

sentences.en: Because of everything that had happened between the Freeman family following Shane's death, the Craig County Sheriff's Department
sentences.zh: 鉴于肖恩死后弗里曼一家之间发生的一切，克雷格县警长部门

sentences.en: had deemed that investigating the fire themselves would be a conflict of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 认为他们自己调查火灾会存在利益冲突。

sentences.en: Agent Steve Nutter from the OSBI eventually arrived at the scene and took over the investigation.
sentences.zh: OSBI的特工史蒂夫·纳特最终赶到现场并接管了调查。

sentences.en: By 5.30pm, the officers had collected all of the evidence and concluded their investigation of the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 到下午5点30分，警官们已经收集了所有证据，并结束了对犯罪现场的调查。

sentences.en: The body that had already been located was identified as Kathy Freeman, yet strangely, the police had been unable to find the remains of Danny, Ashley or Laura.
sentences.zh: 先前找到的尸体被确认是凯茜·弗里曼，然而奇怪的是，警方未能找到丹尼、阿什利或劳拉的遗体。

sentences.en: They told the Bibles they were 100% certain that there were no other bodies in the house.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉拜ible夫妇，他们百分之百确信屋里没有其他尸体。

sentences.en: The Bibles were concerned.
sentences.zh: 拜ible夫妇感到担忧。

sentences.en: As far as they could see, the search had concentrated entirely on the house itself.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，搜索工作完全集中在房子本身上。

sentences.en: No one had searched the rest of the Freeman's
sentences.zh: 没有人搜查弗里曼家其余的

sentences.en: 40-acre property.
sentences.zh: 40英亩土地。

sentences.en: But there was no trace of Danny or the girls.
sentences.zh: 但没有丹尼或女孩们的踪迹。

sentences.en: This raised some serious alarm bells.
sentences.zh: 这敲响了严重的警钟。

sentences.en: Four people had gone to sleep in the Freeman house the night before, but only one was accounted for.
sentences.zh: 前一天晚上有四个人在弗里曼家入睡，但只有一个人的下落有交代。

sentences.en: So, where were Danny, Laura and Ashley?
sentences.zh: 那么，丹尼、劳拉和阿什利在哪里呢？

sentences.en: Laura Bible's parents were taken back to the police station where they were interviewed extensively by OSBI agents.
sentences.zh: 劳拉·拜ible的父母被带回警察局，在那里他们接受了OSBI特工的详细盘问。

sentences.en: A million things were running through their minds as they considered all the possible scenarios.
sentences.zh: 他们脑海中闪过无数的想法，考虑着所有可能的情景。

sentences.en: The prevailing theory was that Danny had killed his wife and then abducted Ashley and Laura.
sentences.zh: 主流理论是丹尼杀死了他的妻子，然后绑架了阿什利和劳拉。

sentences.en: It seemed to be the only thing that made sense.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是唯一说得通的解释。

sentences.en: Otherwise, what else could it be?
sentences.zh: 否则，还能是什么呢？

sentences.en: But there was a problem with this theory.
sentences.zh: 但这个理论存在一个问题。

sentences.en: Both Danny and Kathy's cars were still parked in the driveway and the Freemans didn't own any other vehicles.
sentences.zh: 丹尼和凯茜的车都还停在车道上，而且弗里曼家没有其他车辆。

sentences.en: Laura's car was there as well, with the keys still in the ignition.
sentences.zh: 劳拉的车也在那里，钥匙还插在点火开关里。

sentences.en: Given the remote location, this raised the question of how Danny could have gotten away with Danny could have gotten away with the two teenagers if he was indeed the perpetrator.
sentences.zh: 鉴于地处偏远，这引发了一个问题：如果丹尼确实是凶手，他是怎么带着这两个青少年逃跑的呢？

sentences.en: Lorene Bible informed the OSBI agents that Danny had a history of drug use and had perhaps been involved in some small-time drug dealing.
sentences.zh: 洛伦·拜ible告诉OSBI特工，丹尼有吸毒史，可能曾参与过一些小规模的毒品交易。

sentences.en: This presented another possible scenario.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了另一种可能的场景。

sentences.en: Could it have been a drug deal gone bad?
sentences.zh: 会不会是一场毒品交易谈崩了？

sentences.en: This would explain why all three vehicles were still there.
sentences.zh: 这就能解释为什么三辆车都还在那里。

sentences.en: The police didn't think it had been a random attack.
sentences.zh: 警方认为这并非随机袭击。

sentences.en: The location was too remote, making it highly unlikely that someone would stumble across the Freemans trailer by accident.
sentences.zh: 地理位置太偏远了，使得有人偶然撞见弗里曼家的拖车房的可能性微乎其微。

sentences.en: The possibility that Laura and Ashley could be responsible was quickly deemed unimaginable.
sentences.zh: 劳拉和阿什利可能是凶手的可能性很快就被认为不可想象。

sentences.en: There was simply no way they could have done it.
sentences.zh: 她们根本不可能做出这种事。

sentences.en: Early the next morning of December 31, Agent Steve Nutter received some shocking news.
sentences.zh: 12月31日清晨，史蒂夫·纳特特工接到一个令人震惊的消息。

sentences.en: Kathy Freeman didn't die from the fire.
sentences.zh: 凯茜·弗里曼不是死于火灾。

sentences.en: She died from a shotgun blast to the head.
sentences.zh: 她死于头部遭受的猎枪枪击。

sentences.en: Her time of death was estimated to have been around 5am on Thursday December 30.
sentences.zh: 据估计，她的死亡时间大约在12月30日星期四早上5点左右。

sentences.en: It was also confirmed that the fire had been deliberately lit as an accelerant had been used.
sentences.zh: 经证实，火灾也是人为蓄意点燃的，因为现场使用了助燃剂。

sentences.en: Not long after receiving this information, the police received their first tip-off.
sentences.zh: 在收到这些信息后不久，警方收到了他们的第一条线索。

sentences.en: Someone called in to report that they had seen Danny Freeman in a white Ford truck with Laura and
sentences.zh: 有人打电话报告说，他们在早上7点左右看到丹尼·弗里曼坐在一辆白色的福特卡车里，

sentences.en: Ashley at around 7am.
sentences.zh: 车上还有劳拉和阿什利。

sentences.en: This supported the initial theory that Danny had murdered Kathy before abducting the two teenagers, but it didn't explain why all the cars were still in the driveway.
sentences.zh: 这支持了最初的理论，即丹尼在绑架两名青少年之前谋杀了凯茜，但它没有解释为什么所有的车都还停在车道上。

sentences.en: Furthermore, it was also revealed that through Ashley's job at the convenience store, she had managed to save $4,000 for a car she hoped to buy.
sentences.zh: 此外，据透露，通过在便利店的工作，阿什利设法为她希望购买的一辆汽车存了4000美元。

sentences.en: She kept the cash hidden in a Tupperware container in the freezer of her house, but a search revealed that the money was gone.
sentences.zh: 她把现金藏在家中冰箱的特百惠保鲜盒里，但搜查显示钱不见了。

sentences.en: While this pointed to a potential robbery, Laura's purse was still at the scene with $200 cash inside.
sentences.zh: 虽然这指向了一起潜在的抢劫案，但劳拉的钱包仍然留在现场，里面有200美元现金。

sentences.en: Whichever way you looked at it, nothing seemed to add up.
sentences.zh: 无论从哪个角度来看，一切都毫无头绪。

sentences.en: Early on the morning of December 31, the Bibles returned to the Freeman property.
sentences.zh: 12月31日清晨，拜尔夫妇回到了弗里曼的住所。

sentences.en: Under the assumption that Danny had fled with the girls, the police had cleared the crime scene and released it to the Freeman family, leaving them free to look around.
sentences.zh: 在丹尼带着女孩们逃跑的假设下，警方清理了犯罪现场，并将其交还给了弗里曼家族，让他们可以自由查看。

sentences.en: Laura's parents were desperate for answers and hoped that by revisiting the scene they might notice something the police had missed.
sentences.zh: 劳拉的父母迫切地想要寻找答案，希望通过重返现场，能注意到警方遗漏的某些线索。

sentences.en: They needed to know where their daughter was and were convinced the scene would hold some answers.
sentences.zh: 他们必须知道女儿在哪里，并坚信现场能提供一些答案。

sentences.en: They found an answer alright.
sentences.zh: 他们确实找到了答案。

sentences.en: A very big answer.
sentences.zh: 一个非常重大的答案。

sentences.en: Not long after arriving at the Freeman property and sifting through the wreckage of the burnt trailer, the Bibles found the burnt body of Danny Freeman.
sentences.zh: 在抵达弗里曼住所并仔细搜查被烧毁的拖车残骸后不久，拜尔夫妇就找到了丹尼·弗里曼被烧焦的尸体。

sentences.en: This was a major problem.
sentences.zh: 这是一个大问题。

sentences.en: There was already friction between the Freeman family and the local Sheriff's Department, enough so that the Sheriff's Department
sentences.zh: 弗里曼家族与当地治安官办公室之间已经存在摩擦，矛盾之大，甚至让治安官办公室

sentences.en: had deemed investigating the crime a conflict of interest and called in the OSBI.
sentences.zh: 认为调查此案存在利益冲突，于是请求俄克拉荷马州调查局（OSBI）介入。

sentences.en: Somehow, though, both organisations had managed to miss Danny's body, which took the Bibles all of about five minutes to find upon sifting through the scene.
sentences.zh: 然而不知何故，这两个机构竟然都漏掉了丹尼的尸体，而拜尔夫妇在搜查现场时，仅仅花了大约五分钟就找到了。

sentences.en: Somebody had failed miserably.
sentences.zh: 有人严重失职了。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案卷档案》稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告以支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Case File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《案卷档案》继续为您带来优质内容。

sentences.en: The Bibles called the sheriffs again and they returned to establish another crime scene.
sentences.zh: 拜尔夫妇再次报警，治安官们返回并重新拉起了警戒线。

sentences.en: The OSBI was also called back.
sentences.zh: 俄克拉荷马州调查局（OSBI）也被召回。

sentences.en: The Bibles were told to leave because it was an active crime scene, but they refused.
sentences.zh: 拜尔夫妇被告知离开，因为这里是正在侦办的犯罪现场，但他们拒绝了。

sentences.en: Lorene raised a good point when she said, We let you do your job yesterday, and look how well you did.
sentences.zh: 洛蕾娜说得很有道理，她说：“我们昨天让你们执行公务了，看看你们干得有多好。”

sentences.en: Knowing that their daughter's body could very well be there as well, the Bibles weren't going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 既然深知女儿的尸体很可能也在这里，拜尔夫妇哪儿也不会去。

sentences.en: It was determined that Danny Freeman had also been killed with a shotgun blast to the head.
sentences.zh: 经确定，丹尼·弗里曼也是头部中散弹枪弹身亡。

sentences.en: His charred body was found in the bedroom near where Cathy was found, but there was no shotgun in the room, ruling out the possibility of a murder-suicide.
sentences.zh: 他焦黑的尸体被发现在靠近发现凯茜的卧室里，但房间里没有散弹枪，这排除了谋杀后自杀的可能性。

sentences.en: The Bibles were frantic.
sentences.zh: 拜尔夫妇急疯了。

sentences.en: If the police had missed
sentences.zh: 如果警方漏掉了

sentences.en: Danny's body, there was every chance they had missed Laura and Ashley as well.
sentences.zh: 丹尼的尸体，那么他们同样漏掉劳拉和阿什莉的可能性就太大了。

sentences.en: An extensive search was carried out of the scene, but investigators were absolutely certain there were no other bodies on site and there was still no trace of the two teenagers.
sentences.zh: 现场进行了大规模搜查，但调查人员绝对确信现场没有其他尸体，而且两个少年的踪迹依然全无。

sentences.en: The Bibles' grisly discovery put an end to the theory that Danny had murdered his wife and abducted the girls.
sentences.zh: 拜尔夫妇这起骇人听闻的发现，打破了丹尼谋杀妻子并绑架女孩们的理论。

sentences.en: And obviously, the tip-off the police received earlier was a false lead.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，警方之前收到的线报是一条假线索。

sentences.en: But it did raise the question, could Laura and Ashley be responsible after all?
sentences.zh: 但这确实引发了一个问题：会不会终究是劳拉和阿什莉干的？

sentences.en: It seemed impossible.
sentences.zh: 这似乎不可能。

sentences.en: These were two loving, caring girls who were good at school and had no history of violence.
sentences.zh: 这是两个充满爱心、善解人意的女孩，在学校表现良好，没有任何暴力史。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, it was a possibility the police had to consider.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，这也是警方不得不考虑的一种可能性。

sentences.en: But if there was any truth to it, it still didn't explain how the pair had got away.
sentences.zh: 但如果这是真的，依然无法解释两人是如何逃脱的。

sentences.en: With all the cars in the driveway and Laura's purse found at the scene with her money and ID inside, nothing added up.
sentences.zh: 车道上停着所有的汽车，劳拉的手提包在现场被找到，里面还放着她的钱和身份证，这一切都说不通。

sentences.en: It seemed highly unlikely that the two teenagers would murder Danny and Cathy and then run off into the woods, unless, of course, they had acted in self-defence.
sentences.zh: 这两个少年谋杀丹尼和凯茜然后逃进树林的可能性微乎其微，除非，当然，她们是出于自卫。

sentences.en: It was theorised that Danny and Cathy could have gotten into an argument and Danny had shot Cathy.
sentences.zh: 有推测认为，丹尼和凯茜可能发生了争吵，然后丹尼枪杀了凯茜。

sentences.en: Ashley could have then stepped in to defend her mother by shooting Danny.
sentences.zh: 接着，阿什莉可能为了保护母亲而站出来枪杀了丹尼。

sentences.en: After all, she was an avid hunter who owned her own guns.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，她是一个狂热的猎人，拥有自己的枪支。

sentences.en: Ashley was also one of the very few people who knew about the $4,000 cash in the freezer.
sentences.zh: 阿什莉也是极少数知道冰柜里藏有4000美元现金的人之一。

sentences.en: As crazy as it seemed, it had to be considered.
sentences.zh: 尽管听起来很疯狂，但必须将这一点考虑在内。

sentences.en: And if Ashley hadn't taken the money, then who did?
sentences.zh: 如果阿什莉没有拿走那些钱，那又是谁拿的呢？

sentences.en: Whoever it was, they had to know it was there in the first place.
sentences.zh: 无论是谁，首先必须知道钱就在那里。

sentences.en: As the investigation continued, police learnt that Danny had a large collection of rifles and shotguns.
sentences.zh: 随着调查的深入，警方得知丹尼拥有大量步枪和散弹枪。

sentences.en: Around 14 firearms were recovered at the scene, but police wouldn't say whether or not the murder weapon was among them.
sentences.zh: 现场找回了大约14支枪械，但警方不愿透露凶器是否在其中。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, some members of the Freeman family had a theory of their own.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，弗里曼家族的一些成员提出了他们自己的理论。

sentences.en: They were convinced that the local sheriff's department was responsible, finally putting an end to the bitter feud they'd been having with the Freemans since Shane's death.
sentences.zh: 他们坚信是当地治安官办公室干的，从而彻底结束了自肖恩死后他们与弗里曼家族之间持续至今的苦涩宿怨。

sentences.en: According to one of Danny's relatives, he'd had a conversation with Danny shortly before his death in which Danny had said,
sentences.zh: 根据丹尼的一位亲属所说，他在丹尼死前不久曾与他交谈过，当时丹尼说过，

sentences.en: if anything ever happens to me, look at the sheriff's department.
sentences.zh: 如果我出了什么事，就去查治安官办公室。

sentences.en: He'd been completely serious at the time, pointing a finger in his relative's face.
sentences.zh: 他当时极其严肃，手指着亲属的脸。

sentences.en: While it was entirely possible that Danny had just been letting off steam during a heated discussion when he made this remark, it emerged that the
sentences.zh: 虽然完全有可能丹尼在进行激烈讨论时只是在发泄情绪，但有消息浮出水面，表明

sentences.en: Freemans were actually trying to save enough money to file a wrongful death suit in relation to Shane's shooting.
sentences.zh: 弗里曼一家其实一直在攒钱，准备就肖恩的枪击事件提起非正常死亡诉讼。

sentences.en: Wrongful death suits had to be filed within a year of the event occurring.
sentences.zh: 非正常死亡诉讼必须在事件发生后的一年内提起。

sentences.en: With the one-year anniversary of Shane's death fast approaching, at the time of their deaths, Cathy and Danny had just
sentences.zh: 随着肖恩死亡一周年纪念日迅速临近，在凯茜和丹尼遇害时，他们只剩下

sentences.en: one week to come up with the money before they'd been eligible to file the suit.
sentences.zh: 一周的时间来凑齐这笔钱，然后他们就有资格提起诉讼了。

sentences.en: Danny's relatives said that local deputies were trying to threaten and intimidate Danny from going ahead with the case.
sentences.zh: 丹尼的亲属表示，当地副警长一直试图威胁和恐吓丹尼，阻止他继续推进这个案子。

sentences.en: It was his belief that local deputies had killed Danny and Cathy and buried the girls somewhere.
sentences.zh: 他坚信是当地副警长杀害了丹尼和凯茜，并将女孩们埋在了某个地方。

sentences.en: It was a pretty far reach.
sentences.zh: 这未免有些牵强。

sentences.en: Wrongful death suits are nothing new to police departments, and Shane's death had already been ruled justifiable by the district attorney.
sentences.zh: 非正常死亡诉讼对警察局来说并不新鲜，而且地区检察官已经裁定肖恩的死是正当防卫。

sentences.en: But with members of the Freeman family refusing to let this theory go, the OSBI stepped in and subjected local deputies to a lie detector teSt. All of them passed.
sentences.zh: 但由于弗里曼家族成员拒绝放弃这一推论，俄克拉荷马州调查局（OSBI）介入，对当地副警长实施了测谎。所有人都通过了。

sentences.en: Agent Steve Nutter stated,
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·纳特探员表示：

sentences.en: All cleared themselves as a result of those examinations.
sentences.zh: 通过这些测谎检查，所有人都洗清了嫌疑。

sentences.en: The overall conclusion of our efforts was that the sheriff's office had nothing to do with the murders of Danny and Cathy and did not know the whereabouts of the two missing girls.
sentences.zh: 我们调查工作的总体结论是，治安官办公室与丹尼和凯茜的谋杀案无关，也不知道两名失踪女孩的下落。

sentences.en: But the information that Danny Freeman was trying to come up with money fast did raise some eyebrows.
sentences.zh: 但丹尼·弗里曼一直在急于凑钱这一信息确实引起了一些怀疑。

sentences.en: An autopsy was performed on Danny Freeman and it was revealed that he had a fracture on his right collarbone, indicating there could have been a fierce struggle
sentences.zh: 法医对丹尼·弗里曼进行了尸检，结果显示他的右锁骨骨折，这表明在他被杀前

sentences.en: before he was killed.
sentences.zh: 可能经历过激烈的搏斗。

sentences.en: As mentioned earlier, Danny was believed to be involved in drugs and maybe a little dealing.
sentences.zh: 如前所述，据信丹尼卷入了毒品交易，可能还做点小买卖。

sentences.en: Could he have gotten in over his head looking for a big payday to get enough money together for the lawsuit, only to have the big deal go horribly wrong?
sentences.zh: 他会不会是为了给诉讼凑够钱，去寻找一笔大买卖却越陷越深，结果这笔大买卖出了可怕的差错？

sentences.en: The OSBI didn't think so.
sentences.zh: 俄克拉荷马州调查局（OSBI）并不这么认为。

sentences.en: According to Agent Nutter, nothing suggested a drug-related crime and if it had been drug-related,
sentences.zh: 据纳特探员称，没有任何迹象表明这是一起与毒品有关的犯罪，如果是与毒品有关的，

sentences.en: he thought the very last thing anyone would want to do was abduct the two teenagers.
sentences.zh: 他认为任何人最不想做的事就是绑架这两个少年。

sentences.en: While investigators are privy to information that we aren't, it was a pretty incredible comment to make.
sentences.zh: 虽然调查人员掌握着我们不知道的信息，但这番言论实在令人难以置信。

sentences.en: If it was a drug deal gone wrong, why wouldn't the person or persons responsible for shooting two
sentences.zh: 如果这是一起因毒品交易谈崩而引发的谋杀，为什么枪杀两人

sentences.en: people in the head and burning their house down be capable of abducting Laura and Ashley?
sentences.zh: 头部并烧毁房屋的凶手会没有能力绑架劳拉和阿什莉呢？

sentences.en: There could be several reasons why the perpetrator might want to take the 16-year-old girls.
sentences.zh: 凶手想要带走这两个16岁女孩可能有好几个原因。

sentences.en: On New Year's Day of 2000, the local community banded together and over 500 people performed a large search of the Freeman property.
sentences.zh: 在2000年的元旦，当地社区团结起来，500多人对弗里曼的住所进行了大规模搜查。

sentences.en: But the search turned up nothing.
sentences.zh: 但搜查一无所获。

sentences.en: It was as though Laura and Ashley had disappeared off the face of the earth.
sentences.zh: 就好像劳拉和阿什莉人间蒸发了一样。

sentences.en: On Friday January 7, a memorial service was held for Danny and Kathy Freeman, with over 400 people in attendance.
sentences.zh: 1月7日星期五，丹尼和凯茜·弗里曼举行了追悼会，有400多人出席。

sentences.en: The investigation continued, but the police had nothing.
sentences.zh: 调查仍在继续，但警方一无所获。

sentences.en: No witnesses, no leads, and no real suspects.
sentences.zh: 没有目击证人，没有线索，也没有真正的嫌疑人。

sentences.en: 18 months went by before they got their first solid lead.
sentences.zh: 18个月过去了，他们才得到了第一条有价值的实质性线索。

sentences.en: A couple of inmates at the local county jail reported that they had seen Ashley Freeman and Laura Bible at a farmhouse in Ottawa
sentences.zh: 当地郡监狱里的几名囚犯报告说，在1999年元节前夕，即他们失踪后的第二天，他们曾在渥太华

sentences.en: County on New Year's Eve of 1999, the day after they went missing.
sentences.zh: 郡的一处农舍里看到了阿什莉·弗里曼和劳拉·拜尔。

sentences.en: And it wasn't any old house.
sentences.zh: 那可不是什么普通的房子。

sentences.en: It was a house well known to police.
sentences.zh: 那是一栋警方熟知的房子。

sentences.en: It belonged to a family who were known manufacturers of methamphetamine.
sentences.zh: 它属于一个以制造冰毒而闻名的家族。

sentences.en: According to the inmates, Ashley and Laura were drugged, raped and tortured at the house.
sentences.zh: 据囚犯称，阿什莉和劳拉在那栋房子里被下药、强奸和虐待。

sentences.en: And apparently someone had filmed it.
sentences.zh: 而且显然有人把过程拍了下来。

sentences.en: One of the inmates said he saw the tape.
sentences.zh: 其中一名囚犯说他看过录像带。

sentences.en: Police immediately applied for a search warrant and on July 26, 2001, they raided the house.
sentences.zh: 警方立即申请了搜查令，并于2001年7月26日突袭了这栋房子。

sentences.en: The only thing they found was evidence of drug manufacture, but they did also find a spot of blood.
sentences.zh: 他们唯一找到的是制造毒品的证据，但也发现了一处血迹。

sentences.en: A sample was taken to the lab, but the lab was busy and the Bible family were told they wouldn't have the results back for a year.
sentences.zh: 一份样本被送到实验室，但实验室很忙，拜尔一家被告知要等一年才能拿到结果。

sentences.en: As if Laura and Ashley's loved ones hadn't suffered enough, they now had to wait for a whole year to discover if the story the inmates had given was true.
sentences.zh: 仿佛劳拉和阿什莉的亲人们遭受的痛苦还不够似的，现在他们还得整整等上一年的时间，才能知道囚犯提供的话是否属实。

sentences.en: The results finally came back.
sentences.zh: 结果终于出来了。

sentences.en: It wasn't a match to
sentences.zh: 这与

sentences.en: Ashley or Laura's blood.
sentences.zh: 阿什莉或劳拉的血型不符。

sentences.en: No trace of the girls was found in the house, sending the police straight back to square one.
sentences.zh: 屋里没有找到女孩们的任何踪迹，这让警方直接回到了原点。

sentences.en: Like a lot of cases that garner significant media attention, the investigation into the Freeman Bible case was hindered by bogus tip-offs and unsubstantiated sightings.
sentences.zh: 就像许多受到大量媒体关注的案件一样，对弗里曼-拜尔案的调查受到了虚假线索和未经证实的目击情报的阻碍。

sentences.en: These calls only got worse after a $50,000 reward was offered in exchange for information leading to
sentences.zh: 在悬赏5万美元征集破案线索之后，

sentences.en: an arreSt. Police even received calls placing Ashley and Laura on opposite sides of the country on the same day.
sentences.zh: 这些求助电话变得更加糟糕。警方甚至接到电话称，同一天在国家的两端分别看到了阿什莉和劳拉。

sentences.en: Investigators decided to look into other crimes that had been committed around the same time as
sentences.zh: 调查人员决定调查在同一时期发生的其他犯罪活动，

sentences.en: the Freeman Bible case, both in Oklahoma and in neighbouring states, to see if any similar offences were committed.
sentences.zh: 地点包括俄克拉荷马州及邻近各州，看看是否发生了类似的罪行。

sentences.en: And they found one case that stuck out.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了一个非常突出的案件。

sentences.en: In the early morning hours of December 31,
1999, a 35-year-old man broke into a trailer in Del Rio, Texas after being kicked out of a bar.
sentences.zh: 的清晨，德克萨斯州德尔里奥一名35岁的男子被酒吧赶出来后，闯入了一辆拖车。

sentences.en: He launched a brutal attack on two young girls, 13-year-old Kayleen Harris and her friend, 10-year-old
sentences.zh: 他对两个年轻女孩发动了残忍的袭击，分别是13岁的凯琳·哈里斯和她的朋友、10岁的

sentences.en: Crystal Searles.
sentences.zh: 水晶·西尔斯。

sentences.en: Kayleen was sexually assaulted and stabbed 16 times while Crystal had her throat slit.
sentences.zh: 凯琳遭到性侵并被刺了16刀，而水晶则被割喉。

sentences.en: Kayleen died from her injuries, but miraculously, Crystal survived.
sentences.zh: 凯琳因伤势过重死亡，但奇迹般的是，水晶活了下来。

sentences.en: She managed to go to a neighbour's house and call for help and her attacker was arrested soon after.
sentences.zh: 她设法跑到邻居家呼救，袭击者不久后被捕。

sentences.en: The man was identified as Tommy Lynn
sentences.zh: 这名男子被识别为汤米·林恩

sentences.en: Sells, a drifter who was ultimately suspected of being involved in upwards of 20 murders across the
sentences.zh: ·塞尔斯，他是一个流浪汉，最终被怀疑在美国各地参与了多达20起谋杀案。

sentences.en: United States.
sentences.zh: 美国。

sentences.en: He was sentenced to death for Kayleen's murder and put on death row in Texas.
sentences.zh: 他因谋杀凯琳被判处死刑，并被关押在德克萨斯州的死囚牢房里。

sentences.en: The attack on Kayleen and Crystal had occurred the morning after the Freeman murders, 716 miles away.
sentences.zh: 对凯琳和水晶的袭击发生在弗里曼谋杀案的第二天早晨，两地相距716英里。

sentences.en: Roughly a 10 and a half hour drive.
sentences.zh: 开车大约需要十个半小时。

sentences.en: Agent Nutter and the new Cray County Sheriff Jimmy Souter made their way to Texas to interview Sells.
sentences.zh: 纳特探员和新克雷郡治安官吉米·苏特前往德克萨斯州审讯塞尔斯。

sentences.en: At first he gave them nothing, but after about six hours of interrogation, Sells confessed to having killed Laura Bible and Ashley Freeman.
sentences.zh: 起初他什么也没说，但经过大约六个小时的审讯，塞尔斯承认他杀害了劳拉·拜尔和阿什莉·弗里曼。

sentences.en: He claimed he'd buried them at Red River on the border of Oklahoma and Texas.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己把她们埋在俄克拉荷马州与德克萨斯州交界处的红河。

sentences.en: Police took Sells to the site and he pointed out where he thought the bodies were buried.
sentences.zh: 警方将塞尔斯带到现场，他指出了他认为尸体被埋的地方。

sentences.en: But there was a problem.
sentences.zh: 但问题来了。

sentences.en: The site looked completely different to what Sells had described and no remains were found.
sentences.zh: 现场的景象与塞尔斯描述的完全不同，也没有找到任何遗体。

sentences.en: Sells also lacked any intimate knowledge of the case and only repeated what had already been published in the paper.
sentences.zh: 塞尔斯对该案也缺乏任何深入的了解，只是重复了报纸上已经公开的内容。

sentences.en: Sells had a bit of a habit of confessing to murders.
sentences.zh: 塞尔斯有一种供认谋杀的习惯。

sentences.en: While on death row, he confessed to over 70.
sentences.zh: 在死囚牢房服刑期间，他承认了70多起谋杀。

sentences.en: Despite conclusively linking him to at least 20 cases, the police thought he was playing the system by confessing to a whole heap of crimes that he didn't commit.
sentences.zh: 尽管确凿地将他与至少20起案件联系起来，但警方认为他是在通过承认一大堆自己并未犯下的罪行来玩弄司法系统。

sentences.en: It could have been that he was trying to gain notoriety or perhaps he just liked the attention.
sentences.zh: 可能是他想博取恶名，或者他只是喜欢引人注目。

sentences.en: There wasn't much else to do on death row after all, and confessing to killing Ashley and Laura did get him a day out of his cell.
sentences.zh: 毕竟在死囚牢房里也没什么别的事可做，而承认杀害阿什莉和劳拉确实让他有一天时间可以离开牢房。

sentences.en: As crazy as it sounds, there are a number of reasons why people make false confessions.
sentences.zh: 听起来很疯狂，但人们做出虚假供述的原因有很多。

sentences.en: And given Tommy Lynn Sells was already on death row, he really had nothing to lose.
sentences.zh: 鉴于汤米·林恩·塞尔斯已经在死囚牢房里，他 realmente 确实没什么可失去的了。

sentences.en: It became pretty clear to the police that Sells had nothing to do with the Freeman Bible case,
sentences.zh: 警方很快清楚地认识到，塞尔斯与弗里曼-拜尔案毫无关系，

sentences.en: and he was executed on April 3, 2014, without ever being charged in relation to the crime.
sentences.zh: 他于2014年4月3日被执行死刑，始终未被指控与该罪行有关。

sentences.en: But Sells wasn't the only one who confessed.
sentences.zh: 但塞尔斯并不是唯一一个招供的人。

sentences.en: Back in December 2000, 26-year-old Jeremy
sentences.zh: 早在2000年12月，26岁的杰里米

sentences.en: Brian Jones was wanted on two separate rape charges in Oklahoma.
sentences.zh: ·布莱恩·琼斯因在俄克拉荷马州面临两起独立的强奸指控而被通缉。

sentences.en: He fled to Alabama, where he managed to steal the identity of a man named John Paul Chapman.
sentences.zh: 他逃到了阿拉巴马州，在那里成功盗用了名叫约翰·保尔·查普曼的男子的身份。

sentences.en: Not long after this,
sentences.zh: 这之后不久，

sentences.en: Jones got himself into trouble again and was arrested and fingerprinted.
sentences.zh: 琼斯再次惹上麻烦，被捕并被按了指纹。

sentences.en: The prints were sent to the OSBI and incredibly, their system failed to match Jones' prints to his real identity.
sentences.zh: 指纹被发送给俄克拉荷马州调查局（OSBI），令人难以置信的是，他们的系统未能将琼斯的指纹与他的真实身份匹配起来。

sentences.en: A new profile was created for him under his new Chapman identity, and he was never extradited back to Oklahoma to face the rape charges.
sentences.zh: 他以新的查普曼身份建立了一个新档案，并且他从未被引渡回俄克拉荷马州去面对强奸指控。

sentences.en: On September 18, 2004, a 43-year-old woman named Lisa Nichols was raped and shot dead inside her trailer in Turnerville, Alabama.
sentences.zh: 2004年9月18日，阿拉巴马州特纳维尔，一名43岁名叫丽莎·尼科尔斯的女性在她的拖车内被强奸并枪杀。

sentences.en: Her trailer was then set on fire.
sentences.zh: 随后她的拖车被纵火焚烧。

sentences.en: Jeremy Jones was arrested after it was revealed that his vehicle was seen out the front of Lisa's trailer on the night she was murdered.
sentences.zh: 杰里米·琼斯被捕，此前有迹象表明，在他谋杀丽莎当晚，他的车曾出现在丽莎的拖车门前。

sentences.en: Jones admitted to killing Lisa, but that wasn't all.
sentences.zh: 琼斯承认杀害了丽莎，但不仅如此。

sentences.en: He also confessed to 13 other murders committed across six states.
sentences.zh: 他还承认了在六个州犯下的另外13起谋杀案。

sentences.en: Police could only find enough evidence to charge Jones with three of those crimes, and he was subsequently sentenced to death.
sentences.zh: 警方只找到了足够的证据指控琼斯犯下其中三起罪行，随后他被判处死刑。

sentences.en: While on death row in July 2005, Jones confessed to four more murders – those of Laura Bible and Danny,
sentences.zh: 2005年7月在死囚牢房服刑期间，琼斯又供认了四起谋杀案——即劳拉·拜尔、丹尼、

sentences.en: Kathy and Ashley Freeman.
sentences.zh: 凯茜以及阿什莉·弗里曼的谋杀案。

sentences.en: What interested police was that on the night Danny and Kathy were killed,
sentences.zh: 警方感兴趣的是，在丹尼和凯茜遇害的那天晚上，

sentences.en: Jeremy Jones had been arrested for public intoxication only 16 kilometres or 10 miles from the Freeman home.
sentences.zh: 杰里米·琼斯在距离弗里曼家仅16公里或10英里远的地方因醉酒闹事被捕。

sentences.en: Agent Nutter and Sheriff Souter interviewed Jones.
sentences.zh: 纳特尔警探和苏特警长对琼斯进行了讯问。

sentences.en: At first, he denied any knowledge of the crime, even though he had already confessed to it.
sentences.zh: 起诉之初，他否认自己对这起罪行有任何了解，尽管他此前已经招认。

sentences.en: But as time went on, he started to admit involvement.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，他开始承认自己参与其中。

sentences.en: Jones claimed that Danny Freeman owed him money for drugs, so he shot him, before shooting Kathy and setting their house on fire.
sentences.zh: 琼斯声称丹尼·弗里曼欠他毒资，所以他开枪打死了丹尼，随后又枪杀凯茜并放火烧了他们的房子。

sentences.en: He said he didn't realise that Ashley and Laura were there until they ran out of the house upon hearing the gunshots.
sentences.zh: 他说他直到阿什利和劳拉听到枪声跑出屋子时，才意识到她们也在那里。

sentences.en: According to Jones, the girls asked him for help, so he told them to get in his truck.
sentences.zh: 据琼斯所说，女孩们向他求助，于是他让她们上他的卡车。

sentences.en: From there, he tied them up, killed them and dumped their bodies in a
sentences.zh: 从那里开始，他把她们捆绑起来，杀害并抛尸在一个

sentences.en: Kansas mine shaft.
sentences.zh: 堪萨斯州的矿井深处。

sentences.en: Unlike Tommy Lynn Selzer's confession, Jones knew some things about the case that got investigators' attention.
sentences.zh: 与托马斯·林·塞尔泽的供词不同，琼斯知道一些引起调查人员注意的案件细节。

sentences.en: He knew the exact accelerant that was used to start the fire, as well as the type of shotgun that was used to commit the murders – information that had never been
sentences.zh: 他知道用来纵火的具体助燃剂，以及行凶所用的猎枪型号——这些信息从未

sentences.en: released to be released to the public.
sentences.zh: 向公众公布过。

sentences.en: Police immediately set up a search of the Kansas mine where Jones claimed to have dumped the girls' bodies.
sentences.zh: 警方立即对琼斯声称抛弃女孩尸体的堪萨斯矿井展开搜查。

sentences.en: But there were issues.
sentences.zh: 但这里存在问题。

sentences.en: There were over 100 underground mines in the area, as well as water tunnels, and anything that got dumped in would float away.
sentences.zh: 该地区有100多个地下矿井以及水上隧道，任何被扔进去的东西都会漂走。

sentences.en: Regardless, the area was searched extensively over several days, including the use of underwater camera equipment.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，该地区还是在数天内进行了广泛搜查，包括使用了水下摄像设备。

sentences.en: But no trace of Laura or Ashley was found.
sentences.zh: 但没有找到劳拉或阿什利的丝毫踪迹。

sentences.en: When Jones found out the police had come up empty in the search, he retracted his confession.
sentences.zh: 当琼斯发现警方的搜查一无所获时，他翻供了。

sentences.en: He said he made it all up in order to get special privileges, including extra phone calls, visitations and special meals.
sentences.zh: 他说他这一切都是编造的，目的是为了获得特殊特权，包括额外的通话次数、探视权和特殊伙食。

sentences.en: Police had another look at Jones' arrest for public intoxication.
sentences.zh: 警方重新审视了琼斯因醉酒闹事被捕的事件。

sentences.en: It turned out he was arrested at 4am on December 30, 1999.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，他是在1999年12月30日凌晨4点被捕的。

sentences.en: Kathy and Danny Freeman had been killed at 5am, meaning Jones was already in custody at the time.
sentences.zh: 凯茜和丹尼·弗里曼是在凌晨5点遇害的，这意味着琼斯当时已经被警方拘留。

sentences.en: Ten years after the murders, in 2010, the OSBI released a new piece of information to the public for the first time.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生十年后的2010年，俄克拉何马州调查局首次向公众公布了一条新信息。

sentences.en: They revealed that on the day of the crime, two suspicious vehicles were seen in the area.
sentences.zh: 他们透露，在案发当天，该地区曾出现两辆可疑车辆。

sentences.en: The first was a dark four-door sedan which was seen travelling east on a rural road towards Welch between 5.30 and 6am.
sentences.zh: 第一辆是一辆深色四门轿车，在凌晨5点30分到6点之间，被看到正沿着乡村公路向东朝韦尔奇方向行驶。

sentences.en: The OSBI explained they hadn't released this detail at the time because it was only a vague description and they'd decided to keep the information within law enforcement circles.
sentences.zh: 俄克拉何马州调查局解释说，他们当时没有公布这一细节，是因为这只是一条模糊的描述，他们决定将信息严格保存在执法部门内部。

sentences.en: This was a potentially detrimental decision.
sentences.zh: 这是一个具有潜在破坏性的决定。

sentences.en: Had they released it earlier, someone might have seen it or known someone who drove a similar car.
sentences.zh: 如果他们早点公布，可能会有人看到或认识驾驶类似车辆的人。

sentences.en: After 10 years, it seemed highly unlikely that anyone would remember anything about that car.
sentences.zh: 时隔10年，似乎已经极不可能有人还记得关于那辆车的任何事情了。

sentences.en: The second vehicle seen leaving the area around the time of the crime was a dark-coloured heavy-duty pickup truck heading north towards Kansas.
sentences.zh: 案发前后离开该地区的第二辆车是一辆向北驶向堪萨斯州的深色重型皮卡车。

sentences.en: The OSBI said this information had only come about recently as the result of an interview.
sentences.zh: 俄克拉何马州调查局表示，这条信息是最近通过一次访谈才得知的。

sentences.en: How reliable that information was ten years after the fact was anyone's guess.
sentences.zh: 事发十年后，这条信息的可靠性到底有多高，谁也说不准。

sentences.en: The case remained open and leads continued to be followed up all over the country, but still there was no trace of Laura and Ashley.
sentences.zh: 案件仍然处于悬而未决状态，全国各地的线索也一直在跟进，但劳拉和阿什利仍然杳无音信。

sentences.en: Whatever had happened to them, it seemed highly unlikely that two well-behaved teenagers would be able to commit
sentences.zh: 无论她们遭遇了什么，两个乖巧的青少年竟然能够犯下

sentences.en: such a horrible crime and then vanish without a trace, taking none of their belongings with them.
sentences.zh: 如此可怕的罪行然后人间蒸发，且不带走任何随身物品，这几乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: It's far more likely they were also victims of whoever killed Danny and Kathy.
sentences.zh: 更有可能的是，她们也是杀害丹尼和凯茜的凶手的受害者。

sentences.en: But if that was the case, then why weren't they shot dead and left in the house too?
sentences.zh: 但如果是这样的话，为什么她们没有被枪杀并同样留在屋里呢？

sentences.en: Why were they taken?
sentences.zh: 为什么她们会被带走？

sentences.en: Who took the $4,000 that Ashley had hidden in the freezer and how did they know it was there?
sentences.zh: 是谁拿走了阿什利藏在冰箱里的4000美元，又是怎么知道它在那里的？

sentences.en: In the decades since Ashley and
sentences.zh: 在阿什利和

sentences.en: Laura vanished, Ashley's relatives had her declared legally dead.
sentences.zh: 劳拉失踪后的几十年里，阿什利的亲属已在法律上宣告她死亡。

sentences.en: That was a step the Bible family wouldn't take, refusing to give up hope that Laura might still be alive.
sentences.zh: 这是圣经家族不愿采取的一步，他们拒绝放弃对劳拉可能仍然活着的希望。

sentences.en: Every night, Lorene Bible left the back porch light on, just in case Laura came home.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上，洛娜·圣经都会亮着后廊的灯，以防劳拉回家。

sentences.zh: 早在《案件档案》首次报道弗里曼·圣经案件的

sentences.en: Our episode ended there.
sentences.zh: 我们的单集到这里就结束了。

sentences.en: But it turned out the story was far from over.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，故事远没有结束。

sentences.zh: 《案件档案》很快就会回归。

sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《案件档案》继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: In 2017, the newly appointed Craig County Sheriff Heath Winfrey came across a box of notes
sentences.zh: 2017年，新上任的克雷格县警长希思·温弗瑞偶然发现了一箱笔记

sentences.en: and documents related to the Freeman Bible case that had been pushed aside by the previous administration.
sentences.zh: 和文件，这些是与弗里曼·圣经案相关、被上一任领导层搁置在一边的资料。

sentences.en: Inside, he found something that immediately caught his attention.
sentences.zh: 在里面，他发现了一些立即吸引他注意的东西。

sentences.en: In the days following the fire at the Freeman home, two private investigators had combed the
sentences.zh: 在弗里曼家火灾发生的几天后，两名私家侦探应弗里曼家属的要求对

sentences.en: property at the request of the Freeman family and found a car insurance verification card in the driveway that belonged to a woman named Susan Bailey, not her real name.
sentences.zh: 该房产进行了彻底搜查，并在车道上发现了一张汽车保险验证卡，属于一个名叫苏珊·贝利（化名）的女人。

sentences.en: The private investigators told the police about the card, and although they never took it as evidence, OSBI agents did go to interview Susan.
sentences.zh: 私家侦探将这张卡的事情告诉了警方，尽管警方从未将其作为证据收存，但俄克拉何马州调查局的特工确实去走访了苏珊。

sentences.en: Susan claimed to have no idea why her insurance card was found at the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 苏珊声称完全不知道为什么她的保险卡会在犯罪现场被找到。

sentences.en: She said she'd never met Danny or Cathy Freeman, nor had she ever been anywhere near their home.
sentences.zh: 她说她从未见过丹尼或凯茜·弗里曼，也从未去过他们家附近。

sentences.en: At the time, Susan had a boyfriend named Philip Welch, a known manufacturer and dealer of methamphetamine.
sentences.zh: 当时，苏珊有一个名叫菲利普·韦尔奇的男朋友，他是一个知名的冰毒制造商和贩子。

sentences.en: He sometimes used Susan's car.
sentences.zh: 他有时会使用苏珊的车。

sentences.en: Susan said that Welch knew of Danny Freeman, but did not associate with him.
sentences.zh: 苏珊说韦尔奇知道丹尼·弗里曼，但与他没有来往。

sentences.en: Further documents inside the evidence box revealed that a year after the murders in January 2001, OSBI agent Steve Nutter interviewed a woman named Tracy Ford, not her real name.
sentences.zh: 证据箱内的进一步文件显示，谋杀案发生一年后的2001年1月，俄克拉何马州调查局特工史蒂夫·纳特尔采访了一位名叫特蕾西·福特（化名）的女性。

sentences.en: Tracy told police that just months after the Freemans were killed, Philip Welch broke up with Susan and began a relationship with her instead.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西告诉警方，就在弗里曼夫妇被杀几个月后，菲利普·韦尔奇与苏珊分手，转而与她谈起了恋爱。

sentences.en: The two lived together in a trailer in Pitcher, a small town roughly 25 miles northeast of the Freemans.
sentences.zh: 两人住在距离弗里曼家东北约25英里的小镇皮切尔的一个拖车屋里。

sentences.en: There, Welch often spent time with two of his associates, David Pennington and Ronnie Busick.
sentences.zh: 在那里，韦尔奇经常与他的两个同伙大卫·彭宁顿和罗尼·布西克混在一起。

sentences.en: According to Tracy, the three men said they had killed Danny and Cathy Freeman because Danny owed money for drugs, and they had abducted and killed the two girls.
sentences.zh: 据特蕾西所说，这三名男子声称他们杀了丹尼和凯茜·弗里曼，因为丹尼欠了毒资，并且他们还绑架并杀害了两个女孩。

sentences.en: Philip Welch even kept one of the reward posters on the wall in their house.
sentences.zh: 菲利普·韦尔奇甚至将一张悬赏海报挂在他们屋里的墙上。

sentences.en: Later on,
sentences.zh: 后来，

sentences.en: Tracy said she found a leather briefcase belonging to Welch which contained several Polaroid photographs of two teenage girls lying on Welch's bed.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西说她找到了一个属于韦尔奇的皮质公文包，里面有几张宝丽来照片，拍的是两个十几岁的女孩躺在韦尔奇的床上。

sentences.en: She recognised it from his old bedspread.
sentences.zh: 她从他旧的床单上认出了这个床铺。

sentences.en: The girls were both bound and gagged with duct tape and it was clear they were being held against their will.
sentences.zh: 两个女孩都被胶带捆绑并堵住嘴，很明显她们是在违背意愿的情况下被劫持的。

sentences.en: In one photo,
sentences.zh: 在其中一张照片中，

sentences.en: Philip Welch was lying alongside them.
sentences.zh: 菲利普·韦尔奇正躺在她们旁边。

sentences.en: In another, the girls were duct taped to chairs.
sentences.zh: 在另一张照片中，女孩们被胶带缠在椅子上。

sentences.en: Tracy recognised the girls from the missing person poster in their house, Laura Bible and Ashley Freeman.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西从他们屋里的失踪人口海报上认出了这两个女孩，即劳拉·圣经和阿什利·弗里曼。

sentences.en: Tracy said she confronted Welch about the Polaroids and he warned that if she ever told anyone, she would end up in a pit in picture like those two girls.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西说她就这些宝丽来照片质问了韦尔奇，而韦尔奇警告说，如果她把这事告诉任何人，她就会像那两个女孩一样落得个被抛进皮切尔矿坑的下场。

sentences.en: Philip Welch was interviewed two years after Tracy's claims, but why nothing further came of this line of enquiry is unknown.
sentences.zh: 在特蕾西爆料两年后，警方对菲利普·韦尔奇进行了讯问，但这条调查线索为什么没有进一步进展则不得而知。

sentences.en: The box of documents found in 2017 was handed over to an investigator for the district attorney
sentences.zh: 2017年发现的那箱文件被移交给了一名地区检察官的调查员

sentences.en: and an OSBI agent who were now jointly leading the investigation into the Freeman Bible case.
sentences.zh: 以及一名俄克拉何马州调查局特工，他们现在正共同领导对弗里曼·圣经案的调查。

sentences.en: They began speaking to various associates of Philip Welch, David Pennington and Ronnie Busick.
sentences.zh: 他们开始与菲利普·韦尔奇、大卫·彭宁顿和罗尼·布西克的各种同伙交谈。

sentences.en: At least 12 witnesses backed up the claims made by Tracy Ford, saying they too had seen the Polaroids of Laura and Ashley.
sentences.zh: 至少有12名证人证实了特蕾西·福特的说法，称他们也见过劳拉和阿什利的宝丽来照片。

sentences.en: One witness described the girls as looking emaciated.
sentences.zh: 一名证人形容女孩们看起来骨瘦如柴。

sentences.en: Another said Ronnie
sentences.zh: 另一位则说罗尼

sentences.en: Busick admitted that the trio had taken the girls to a trailer in Pitcher where they had tortured and raped them for several days.
sentences.zh: 布西克承认，这三人把女孩们带到了皮切尔的一间拖车屋里，并在那里对她们进行了数天的折磨和强奸。

sentences.en: Tracy's son said that Philip Welch and David Pennington had shown him the photos and said they had strangled the two girls to death.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西的儿子说，菲利普·韦尔奇和大卫·彭宁顿曾向他展示过这些照片，并称他们已经将两个女孩勒死。

sentences.en: At one point, Tracy and her son had gone to live with a friend to escape Welch's physical abuse.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，特蕾西和她的儿子曾去和一个朋友同住，以逃避韦尔奇的身体虐待。

sentences.en: The friend told the police that Welch had called constantly, saying he was involved with the Freeman case and threatening to kill her and her children and
sentences.zh: 这位朋友告诉警方，韦尔奇曾不断打电话，声称自己卷入了弗里曼案，并威胁要杀了她和她的孩子，把他们

sentences.en: throw them into the pit with the missing girls.
sentences.zh: 扔进关着失踪女孩的矿坑里。

sentences.en: According to Tracy's friend, it was Welch who had pulled the trigger on Danny and Kathy before instructing Pennington and Busick to start the fire,
sentences.zh: 据特蕾西的朋友所说，是韦尔奇对丹尼和凯茜扣动了扳机，然后指示彭宁顿和布西克放火，

sentences.en: a claim that was backed by several others.
sentences.zh: 这一说法得到了其他几人的证实。

sentences.en: Multiple people said that Welch was the mastermind behind the crimes, while Pennington and Busick had been involved to varying levels.
sentences.zh: 多名知情人称，韦尔奇是这些罪行的幕后主使，而彭宁顿和布西克则在不同程度上参与其中。

sentences.en: Witnesses either hadn't come forward out of fear or because they thought it was such common knowledge that police already knew.
sentences.zh: 证人们要么是因为恐惧而没有站出来，要么是认为这是众所周知的常识，警方本就知情。

sentences.en: An ex-girlfriend of Pennington's named Leanne, not her real name, said that during the course of their
sentences.zh: 彭宁顿的前女友名叫利安妮（化名），她说在两人

sentences.en: relationship, Pennington had often bragged that he and at least two other men had killed the Freemans over a bad drug deal.
sentences.zh: 交往期间，彭宁顿经常吹嘘说他和至少另外两名男子因一笔失败的毒品交易而杀害了弗里曼一家。

sentences.en: He allegedly told Leanne that Laura and Ashley had walked into the room at the time and that the men had decided to quote, take the girls and have fun with them.
sentences.zh: 据称他告诉利安妮，劳拉和阿什利当时走进了房间，这几个男人便决定“带走女孩并找点乐子”。

sentences.en: Leanne said that
sentences.zh: 利安妮说

sentences.en: Pennington had talked about Laura and Ashley all the time.
sentences.zh: 彭宁顿一直在谈论劳拉和阿什利。

sentences.en: He said their bodies were in a pit somewhere and warned Leanne that if she ever told anyone or tried to leave him, she would end up in the pit too.
sentences.zh: 他说她们的尸体在某处的矿坑里，并警告利安妮，如果她敢告诉任何人或者试图离开他，她也会落得同样的下场。

sentences.en: She eventually became so terrified of him that she'd gone into hiding.
sentences.zh: 她最终被他吓得躲了起来。

sentences.en: It turned out that the two private investigators who had initially found Susan Bailey's insurance card at the crime scene just
sentences.zh: 原来，那两名在谋杀案发生几天后最初在犯罪现场找到苏珊·贝利保险卡的

sentences.en: days after the murders had interviewed a number of these witnesses in the early days of the investigation, including Philip Walsh.
sentences.zh: 私家侦探，在调查的早期阶段曾采访过其中几位证人，包括菲利普·沃尔什（韦尔奇）。

sentences.en: They'd even later tracked down Susan Bailey's car at a salvage yard and found documents inside that linked the car to Walsh.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至后来在一个废品场找到了苏珊·贝利的汽车，并在车内发现了将该车与沃尔什联系起来的文件。

sentences.en: They had tried to hand over the information they'd uncovered to the Craig County Sheriff's Department, but the office had refused to take it.
sentences.zh: 他们曾试图将自己挖掘出的信息移交给克雷格县警长办公室，但该办公室拒绝接收。

sentences.en: One of the private investigators had since passed away and the information he'd gathered had subsequently been destroyed.
sentences.zh: 其中一名私家侦探自那以后已经去世，他收集的信息随之被销毁。

sentences.en: However, the other PI still had a copy of Susan Bailey's insurance card and handed it over to the new investigation team.
sentences.zh: 然而，另一名私家侦探仍然保留着苏珊·贝利保险卡的副本，并将其交给了新的调查团队。

sentences.en: He said he'd stopped looking into the case years ago after a member of law enforcement told him he was interfering and had threatened to cancel his
sentences.zh: 他说，由于一名执法人员曾告诉他在干预案件并威胁如果他不停手就吊销他的

sentences.en: private investigator license if he didn't stop.
sentences.zh: 私家侦探执照，他多年前就已经停止调查这个案子了。

sentences.en: For the current investigators, there was only one thing left to do and that was to interview the three men in question, Phil Welch, David Pennington and
sentences.zh: 对于现任调查人员来说，只剩下一件事要做，那就是讯问涉案的三名男子：菲尔·韦尔奇、大卫·彭宁顿和

sentences.en: Ronnie Busiek.
sentences.zh: 罗尼·布西克。

sentences.en: But there was a big problem.
sentences.zh: 但这里有一个大问题。

sentences.en: Phil Welch died in 2007 and David Pennington died in 2015.
sentences.zh: 菲尔·韦尔奇于2007年去世，大卫·彭宁顿于2015年去世。

sentences.en: Ronnie Busiek was the only surviving member of the trio.
sentences.zh: 罗尼·布西克是这三人中唯一在世的成员。

sentences.en: The 65-year-old was called in for questioning three times throughout 2017.
sentences.zh: 这位65岁的老人在2017年间被三次传唤接受讯问。

sentences.en: While he admitted to knowing Pennington, he initially denied having any association with Philip Welch.
sentences.zh: 虽然他承认认识彭宁顿，但他最初否认自己与菲利普·韦尔奇有任何交往。

sentences.en: That was until police revealed that witnesses had linked the three of them to the Freeman Bible case.
sentences.zh: 直到警方透露有证人将他们三人与弗里曼·圣经案联系在一起。

sentences.en: Busiek then admitted that the three men were pretty tight back in those days.
sentences.zh: 布西克这才承认这三人当年关系相当铁。

sentences.en: Although, he said he never liked Welch as he was shady and had a bad temper.
sentences.zh: 不过，他说他从来不喜欢韦尔奇，因为他鬼鬼祟祟且脾气暴躁。

sentences.en: Busiek initially said he only knew about the murders from the news, but when pushed, he conceded that
sentences.zh: 布西克最初声称他只是从新闻中得知这些谋杀案，但在追问之下，他承认

sentences.en: Philip Welch was likely responsible because he was quote, cold-blooded and mean enough to do it.
sentences.zh: 菲利普·韦尔奇很可能是罪魁祸首，因为他“心狠手辣，做得出这种事”。

sentences.en: He also admitted that David Pennington might have been involved, saying he had been acting suspicious and sheepish around the time.
sentences.zh: 他还承认大卫·彭宁顿可能也参与其中，称他在当时表现得鬼鬼祟祟、畏畏缩缩。

sentences.en: Busiek knew that Susan Bailey's insurance card had been found at the scene.
sentences.zh: 布西克知道苏珊·贝利的保险卡在现场被找到。

sentences.en: He claimed Pennington had told him about it and that this had added to his suspicions against the two men.
sentences.zh: 他声称彭宁顿跟他提起过这件事，这加深了他对这两个人的怀疑。

sentences.en: At first, Busiek said nothing when the investigators accused him of being at the Freemans on the night of the crimes.
sentences.zh: 起初，当调查人员指控他在案发当晚去过弗里曼家时，布西克一言不发。

sentences.en: Then he switched back and forth between outright denying his involvement and claiming he couldn't remember anything.
sentences.zh: 随后他在彻底否认自己参与和声称自己什么都不记得之间反复横跳。

sentences.en: He said witnesses were lying about his involvement but offered no explanation as to why they would be motivated to do so.
sentences.zh: 他说证人们在关于他参与的事情上撒谎，但没有解释这些人为什么要这么做。

sentences.en: During his third interrogation, one of the agents asked Busiek what was keeping him from telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 在他的第三次审讯中，一名特工问布西克是什么阻碍他说出真相。

sentences.en: Surely, they said, this whole situation must have been eating at him for the past 17 years.
sentences.zh: 他们说，整件事在过去17年里肯定一直在折磨着他。

sentences.en: You're scared of what your sister would think about you if you told the truth.
sentences.zh: 你是在害怕如果你说出真相，你姐姐会怎么看你。

sentences.en: That's what it is, right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吧？

sentences.en: The agent posited.
sentences.zh: 特工推测道。

sentences.en: Busiek's response was simple.
sentences.zh: 布西克的回答很简单。

sentences.en: Well, yeah.
sentences.zh: 好吧，是的。

sentences.en: Although he nodded along when the agent said it would be a relief to get it off his chest, he stopped short of admitting to anything.
sentences.zh: 尽管当特工说把事情说出来会是一种解脱时他跟着点了点头，但他还是没有做出任何实质性的供认。

sentences.en: On April 23, 2018, almost 18 and a half years after the crimes,
sentences.zh: 2018年4月23日，在案发将近十八年半之后，

sentences.en: Ronnie Busiek was arrested and charged with four counts of first-degree murder, two counts of kidnapping, and one count of first-degree arson.
sentences.zh: 罗尼·布西克被捕，并被控四项一级谋杀罪、两项绑架罪和一项一级纵火罪。

sentences.en: Upon his arrest, he said he was willing to talk to Laura and Ashley's families.
sentences.zh: 被捕后，他表示愿意与劳拉和阿什利的家属交谈。

sentences.en: Laura's mother, Lorraine, went to meet with Busiek one-on-one.
sentences.zh: 劳拉的母亲洛娜亲自去见布西克。

sentences.en: She told him that she didn't come to harass or upset him, but as a mother trying to find her child.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他，她来不是为了骚扰或激怒他，而是一位寻找孩子的母亲。

sentences.en: Busiek replied, I wish I could tell you.
sentences.zh: 布西克回答说，我希望我能告诉你。

sentences.en: I wish I could tell you where your daughter is.
sentences.zh: 我希望我能告诉你你的女儿在哪里。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't know anything.
sentences.zh: 我什么也不知道。

sentences.en: He said something similar to Ashley's uncle when he asked where his niece was.
sentences.zh: 当阿什利的叔叔问他侄女在哪里时，他也做出了类似的回答。

sentences.en: I wish I could, Busiek replied.
sentences.zh: 布西克回答说，我希望能知道。

sentences.en: I don't have a clue.
sentences.zh: 我毫无头绪。

sentences.en: In 2019, a jury found Ronnie
sentences.zh: 2019年，陪审团裁定罗尼

sentences.en: Busiek competent to stand trial, but in July 2020, he accepted a plea deal.
sentences.zh: 布西克具有接受审判的行为能力，但在2020年7月，他接受了一项认罪协议。

sentences.en: In exchange for just 10 years behind bars, Busiek pleaded guilty to the lesser crimes of being an accessory to first-degree murder
sentences.zh: 作为仅在狱中服刑10年的交换条件，布西克对较轻的一级谋杀从犯罪行表示认罪

sentences.en: in the deaths of Danny and Kathy Freeman, the arson of their home, and the abduction and presumed murders of Laura and Ashley.
sentences.zh: 在丹尼和凯茜·弗里曼之死、他们房屋的纵火案，以及劳拉和阿什利的绑架及推定谋杀案中。

sentences.en: As part of the plea deal, he agreed to assist investigators in finding the girl's remains.
sentences.zh: 作为认罪协议的一部分，他同意协助调查人员寻找女孩们的遗骸。

sentences.en: If the recovery was successful, Busiek's sentence would be reduced to just five years.
sentences.zh: 如果搜寻成功，布西克的刑期将减至仅仅五年。

sentences.en: According to Busiek, Welch and Pennington had held Laura and Ashley captive for about two weeks, during which they were raped and tortured before eventually being killed.
sentences.zh: 据布西克供称，韦尔奇和彭宁顿曾将劳拉和阿什利囚禁约两周，在此期间她们遭到强奸和折磨，最终被杀害。

sentences.en: He claimed not to know how they were killed or where their remains were disposed of.
sentences.zh: 他声称不知道她们是如何被杀害的，也不知道她们的遗骸被抛弃在何处。

sentences.en: Around the time of the murders,
sentences.zh: 在谋杀案发生前后，

sentences.en: Busiek said that Pennington had mentioned something about filling in an old root cellar at his former property in Pitcher.
sentences.zh: 布西克称彭宁顿曾提到过有关填平他在皮彻旧房产处的一个旧地窖的事情。

sentences.en: In August 2020, searches were conducted of the property in question, but no sign of Laura or Ashley's remains were found.
sentences.zh: 2020年8月，有关部门对涉事房产进行了搜查，但没有找到任何劳拉或阿什利遗骸的迹象。

sentences.en: Those on site described Busiek as looking genuinely surprised.
sentences.zh: 现场人员形容布西克看上去是真的感到惊讶。

sentences.en: His lawyer said that Welch and Pennington had never told Busiek what they did with the girls and any information he had provided was merely a guess.
sentences.zh: 他的律师表示，韦尔奇和彭宁顿从未告诉过布西克他们对女孩们做了什么，他提供的任何信息都纯属猜测。

sentences.en: In the lead-up to Busiek's sentencing, Lorene Bible provided an emotional victim impact statement that spoke of the pain her family had endured for the past two decades.
sentences.zh: 在布西克被判刑之前，洛琳·拜布尔发表了一份充满情感的受害者影响陈述，诉说了她的家庭在过去二十年中承受的痛苦。

sentences.en: 20 years, eight months, and one day ago, on December 30, 1999, you made a choice, Lorene wrote.
sentences.zh: 20年前、8个月零1天前，即1999年12月30日，你做出了一个选择，洛琳写道。

sentences.en: You chose to go with two other men and changed the course of so many lives, including your own.
sentences.zh: 你选择与另外两个男人同行，改变了无数人的人生轨迹，包括你自己的。

sentences.en: You are one of three men responsible for taking two innocent girls' lives.
sentences.zh: 你是夺走两个无辜女孩生命的三个凶手之一。

sentences.en: You could have done something to stop it, you could have called and reported that you were a part of something awful, but you did not.
sentences.zh: 你本可以做些什么来阻止这一切，你本可以打电话报告说你参与了一件可怕的事情，但你没有。

sentences.en: Instead, you continued to be a part of the unthinkable things our girls endured before you were a part of ending their lives.
sentences.zh: 相反，你继续参与了我们女孩们在被你参与结束生命之前所承受的那些不可想象的事情。

sentences.en: You had a choice.
sentences.zh: 你本有选择。

sentences.en: They were young and beautiful, but you know that.
sentences.zh: 她们年轻而美丽，但你心里清楚。

sentences.en: They were innocent, but you and your other buddies took that from them.
sentences.zh: 她们是无辜的，但你和你的其他同伙剥夺了这一切。

sentences.en: They did nothing to you.
sentences.zh: 她们没有对你做过任何事。

sentences.en: They did not owe you or anyone else anything.
sentences.zh: 她们不欠你或任何其他人什么。

sentences.en: Their lives were only just about to begin.
sentences.zh: 她们的人生才刚刚开始。

sentences.en: You took that.
sentences.zh: 你夺走了这一切。

sentences.en: They didn't have a choice.
sentences.zh: 她们没有选择。

sentences.en: Our lives changed.
sentences.zh: 我们的人生改变了。

sentences.en: The pain you have brought to us is indescribable.
sentences.zh: 你带给我们的痛苦是无法形容的。

sentences.en: It's unfair.
sentences.zh: 这太不公平了。

sentences.en: Because of your choices, we don't sleep.
sentences.zh: 因为你的选择，我们无法入睡。

sentences.en: We don't have a single day that we aren't searching.
sentences.zh: 我们没有一天不在寻找。

sentences.en: We don't walk into a crowd, first without looking for her and then wondering if every person in the crowd could cause us more harm.
sentences.zh: 我们走进人群时，总是先寻找她的身影，然后又在猜想人群中的每个人会不会给我们带来更多的伤害。

sentences.en: We don't allow our other children to go to sleepovers, have playdates, or trust anyone to be near them.
sentences.zh: 我们不允许其他孩子去参加留宿派对、玩耍约会，也不敢相信任何人能靠近他们。

sentences.en: We have nightmares.
sentences.zh: 我们做着噩梦。

sentences.en: We mourn every single day and will continue to do so until the day we can bring the girls home, and then we will mourn in another way.
sentences.zh: 我们每一天都在哀悼，并且将继续下去，直到我们能把女孩们带回家那一天，然后我们将以另一种方式哀悼。

sentences.en: We don't have a choice.
sentences.zh: 我们别无选择。

sentences.en: Ronnie Busick was subsequently sentenced to 10 years in prison, followed by 5 years probation, with credit for time already served.
sentences.zh: 罗尼·布西克随后被判处10年监禁，缓刑5年，并折抵已服刑期。

sentences.en: Further searches were conducted, but all were fruitless.
sentences.zh: 随後又进行了搜查，但都无功而返。

sentences.en: In May 2023, after serving just 38 months of his sentence, it was announced that Ronnie Busick was being released early for good behaviour.
sentences.zh: 2023年5月，在服刑仅38个月后，官方宣布罗尼·布西克因表现良好获准提前假释。

sentences.en: Laura and Ashley's loved ones were furious.
sentences.zh: 劳拉和阿什利的亲人们愤怒不已。

sentences.en: Had they known this was possible, they never would have agreed to the plea deal.
sentences.zh: 如果他们早知道这是可能的，他们绝不会同意认罪协议。

sentences.en: The decision caused such an uproar that in May 2025, the Governor of
sentences.zh: 这一决定引发了巨大的轰动，以至于在2025年5月，

sentences.en: Oklahoma passed a new bill requiring felons convicted of accessory to murder to serve at least 85% of their sentence before being eligible for parole.
sentences.zh: 俄克拉荷马州州长签署了一项新法案，要求因谋杀从犯而被定罪的重罪犯必须服满至少85%的刑期才有资格获得假释。

sentences.en: This legislation is known as Laura and Ashley's Law.
sentences.zh: 这项立法被称为“劳拉与阿什利法案”。

sentences.en: As of January 2026, the remains of Laura Bible and Ashley Freeman have never been recovered, nor have the Polaroids depicting their torture.
sentences.zh: 截至2026年1月，劳拉·拜布尔和阿什利·弗里曼的遗骸仍未找到，描绘她们遭受酷刑的宝丽来照片也未找到。

sentences.en: Laura's mother, Lorene Bible, continues to advocate for further searches.
sentences.zh: 劳拉的母亲洛琳·拜布尔继续呼吁进行进一步的搜查。

sentences.en: Like many others, she believes Ronnie Busick knows where the remains of her daughter are located.
sentences.zh: 和许多人一样，她相信罗尼·布西克知道她女儿的遗骸在哪里。

sentences.en: When Busick was released from prison, Lorene stood outside waiting for him.
sentences.zh: 当布西克从监狱释放时，洛琳站在外面等他。

sentences.en: While she didn't wish him any harm and forgave him on a fundamental level, she wanted him to know that she would always be watching and questioning his every move.
sentences.zh: 虽然她并不希望他受到伤害，并在根本上原谅了他，但她希望他知道，她会永远盯着并质疑他的一举一动。

sentences.en: I want him to know that I'm here, she told reporters.
sentences.zh: 我想让他知道我在这里，她对记者说。

sentences.en: And I'm not going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 而且我哪儿也不去。

sentences.en: I want her to know that I'm going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 我想让她知道我要去任何地方。
